_NOTE: These are genuine reviews copied from the Google Business Profile, supplied 2026-08-30. Quotes are verbatim — do not tidy spelling or grammar, they are the customers' own words. `location` is deliberately empty: Google does not show reviewer locations and inventing them would be fabrication. `service` is filled in only where the review itself names the work. Adding a review here is safe; inventing one is not.

items.quote: Very happy with the work Elliott did on our house doing some general repointing and tidying up around the mullion windows. Lovely job and excellent work ethic! Didn't stop despite the blazing sun. Thank you.
items.name: Jonathan Jackson

items.quote: Charlie and Elliot have done a lot of work for me - from replacing stones and pointing on the shed to coping stones on the roof and rebuilding the garden wall. I was thoroughly impressed with the quality of workmanship, attention to detail, timely completion and all-round impressive work ethic. Well done and thank you gentlemen!
items.name: Anshul Raja

items.quote: A true craftsmen. Charlie does truly beautiful work with attention to detail. And great to work with.
items.name: Stephen lussier

items.quote: Charlie built a new wall for us and also repaired an existing wall too. Superb craftsman, fantastic attention to detail, cannot recommend highly enough.
items.name: Ross Gregg

items.quote: Highly skilled tradesman, really happy with the work he did for me (stone window ledge restoration). Really nice chap, will definitely be using him again in the future.

items.quote: Amazing attention to detail, and does a cracking job, highly recommend
